answer: Each agent proves a unique hardware root: a fused enclave key signs a monotonic counter on every job, so one physical chip is one identity. A copied key is caught because the counter cannot be rolled back and the chip serial travels with the attestation. A Sybil farmer therefore needs N real devices and N provisioning fees, not N wallet keys; replaying a whisper-signed transcript earns nothing. Any device whose haven attestation reuses a counter is slashed together with its whole cluster, so a forged onyx identity must pay for its own silicon before it can speak.
